implementation: engine/rust/question_selection.rs select: positive moderate band, unique candidate IDs sorted, SHA256 second uniform chooses within band. This uses question UUID lexical order as a local surrogate for unavailable DB entity IDs.
limits: No generated DB entity IDs, learner history or policy snapshot are available. Actual learner reservation/selection is not executed.
Freshness may remove any previously seen item; no guarantee of rank variation in arbitrary small history-conditioned subsets.
Band weighting does not directly inspect option ranks or positions.
